caption: The image shows a piece of fabric, possibly linen or cotton, with numerous embroidered motifs scattered across its surface. The embroidery features a series of floral and leaf-like shapes, stitched in various shades of blue, red, gold, and some off-white or cream threads. The designs include looping, curving stems and tendrils, flower-like forms with radiating petals, and simpler geometric shapes resembling buds or blossoms. Some motifs appear to resemble stylized flowers with radiating petals, while others are more abstract or geometric. The stitches are primarily smooth and dense, with some areas having zigzag or scalloped outlines. The composition is loosely arranged, with the elements spaced irregularly across the fabric, and there are no repeating patterns or borders. The background fabric is a light beige or off-white color, allowing the colorful threads of the embroidery to stand out.
title: Embroidered Petticoat (Detail)
